purpose: Manual activation evaluation for the four non-Blender canonical skills. Cases identify the primary owner; companion skills may also apply. Present prompts without expected routes, then compare. Integrity tests do not measure model activation.

should_trigger: Add a Tools_C contract rule that rejects duplicate declared resource IDs and prove the failure case.
A recurring checker defect needs a durable lesson or a reliable L1 rule; update the owning tests.
should_not_trigger: Run the existing checker on this Godot project and report its current failures.
Fix a character's shoulder deformation in Blender.

edge.prompt: The project profile has a stale resource path; determine whether the local contract or universal checker must change.
edge.reason: Inspect actual project ownership before changing a local rule or universal checker.

should_trigger: A reimport removes an editor-authored offset; fix scene ownership in this Godot project.
Update a shared Godot Resource for one instance without changing its siblings.
should_not_trigger: Rig and animate the source character in Blender only.
Add a new Tools_C JSON contract kind without editing a Godot project.

edge.prompt: A GLB imports into Godot but its material looks wrong in the project scene.
edge.reason: The target scene and visual evidence must distinguish import from appearance.

should_trigger: Audit this project's current branch, dirty files, instructions and active scene before planning changes.
Connect this existing repository to Tools_C while preserving its AGENTS.md and user edits.
should_not_trigger: Adjust a single named Godot node and test its runtime behavior.
Review only the before and after renders of a Blender sculpt.

edge.prompt: An old handoff names an 18-bone rig, while the current asset may use another skeleton.
edge.reason: Current consumers and profile must establish which statement is active.

should_trigger: Check whether this change actually works at runtime and whether another instance regressed.
Compare fixed camera views before and after a mesh correction and report any unrun checks.
should_not_trigger: Create a new scene script without asking for a review.
Design a new contract rule and its validator.

edge.prompt: The import command exited successfully; can we claim the animation looks and plays correctly?
edge.reason: L2 import success does not establish L3 playback or L4 visual quality.
